create_shampoo_preconditioner_config: create a RootInvShampooPreconditionerConfig dataclass to configure Shampoo preconditioner with inverse root computation
create_adam_preconditioner_config: create an AdamPreconditionerConfig dataclass to configure Adam-style preconditioner with beta2 and epsilon settings
create_ddp_distributed_config: create a DDPDistributedConfig dataclass to configure distributed data parallel computation for Shampoo
create_gpa_iterate_averaging_config: create a GeneralizedPrimalAveragingConfig dataclass to configure generalized primal averaging with eval and train interpolation coefficients
create_schedule_free_config: create a ScheduleFreeConfig dataclass to configure schedule-free optimization with automatic learning rate adaptation
